steps: Place a level on top of the washer, front-to-back and side-to-side.
Loosen the locknuts on the adjustable feet.
Turn the feet to raise/lower each corner until level.
Tighten the locknuts back against the cabinet base.
Run a spin cycle to confirm vibration/walking has stopped.
